title: Innkeeper's Lockbox
summary: Open the lockbox to search for its contents. Use the Innkeeper’s Key to unlock it.

fields.Effect: Open the lockbox to search for its contents. Use the Innkeeper’s Key to unlock it.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Durability: 50 object HP. Medium Toughness requires at least 22 damage in one hit. Resists Piercing, Necrotic and Radiant, and is immune to Poison and Psychic.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
